change: Secondary changed from 'Lower Back (Erector Spinae)' + 'abs' to 'mid back (Rhomboids, Lower Traps)' + 'biceps (Biceps Brachii)'. This is a clasped-hands-behind-back chest/shoulder stretch; sources describe pulling shoulder blades together/down (scapular retractors = rhomboids/lower traps) and stretching the biceps with straight arms. Lower back and abs are not meaningfully involved; the cue is to arch the upper back, not the lower back. Primary (chest + anterior deltoids) confirmed correct.
